title: Chapter 571 - Lord Hu Suo
content:
Chapter 571 - Lord Hu Suo

Chapter 571 - Lord Hu Suo

A powerful aura appeared in the air, causing the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi to howl and everything within several thousand miles to tremble in fear.

This force seemed to be one with the universe.

“What the…? How did he catch up?”

Everyone within the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship could clearly feel the aura of a Great Origin Core Realm approaching, and this time, the aura was heading straight toward them.

Wu~~

The mist of the ocean started to fade away and was replaced by a green-and-blood-colored light. Everything within several dozen miles was instantly covered by this light, and the whole area seemed to become another world.

In the depths of the ocean, the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship stopped moving and concealed its aura once more.

Peng! Peng! Peng!

The hearts of all the sailors and Loulan Zhishui thumped.

Within one of the cabins:

“We’ve been spotted.”

Zhao Feng sighed and stood up.

Hearing that, the hearts of everyone shook.

“Zhao Feng, I know you’re down there. Come out and die.”

A cold, vengeful male’s voice sounded from above.

Zhao Feng and Loulan Zhishui both felt like this voice was familiar.

Sou! Sou! Sou~~~

Three Origin Core Realm auras stopped in the air above the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship.

The speaker was the Blue Lightning Pirate.

Of the three Sovereigns, he stood on the left. On the right side was a black-faced, black-armored giant whose cultivation had reached the late-stage, verging-on-peak-stage Small Origin Core Realm.

The person in the middle was a one-armed bald man with green tattoos. The green-and-blood-colored light was coming from his body.

He was a Great Origin Core Realm Sovereign Lord.

“To be able to change the environment and nature itself… so this is the Great Origin Core Realm.”

At this moment, Zhao Feng stopped blocking his God’s Spiritual Eye and saw the scenery on the surface of the ocean. He then put the images inside the minds of Loulan Zhishui and company.

“It’s him! He’s the pirate leader of the ten great pirates and the Pirate King of this part of the limitless ocean – Lord Hu Suo!”

Loulan Zhishui exclaimed.

Lord Hu Suo, the leader of the pirate alliance!

The hearts of the sailors shook, and they felt as if they were standing on a cliff.

Plop!

One or two of them even fell on their butts.

Zhao Feng’s eyebrows furrowed. The attitudes and characteristics of the sailors he chose weren’t weak, so how famous was Lord Husuo? Just his name alone made them lose the will to fight.

“This part of the limitless ocean can be said to be his territory. He has been pillaging near the Eight Desolate Mountain for several hundred years, and apart from the three sects, he’s not scared to plunder anyone else.”

Loulan Zhishui’s voice trembled.

At this moment, the pressure from the Great Origin Core Realm was becoming stronger and stronger.

“Get ready to fight.”

Zhao Feng leapt onto the deck, and a black flag appeared in his hand.

“Great Origin Core Realm expert…. The Scarlet Moon Patriarch was only at that level.”

The skeletal Division Leader said bitterly. It had personally witnessed the Patriarch’s strength, and the pressure from Lord Hu Suo was only slightly weaker than the Scarlet Moon Patriarch.

In the air:

“Lord Hu, let me go down and get rid of them.”

The black-armored giant waved a black axe and revealed a gruesome expression. In terms of battle-strength, he was even slightly stronger than the Blue Lightning Pirate.

“No.”

Lord Hu Suo spoke, “You can kill everyone else, but that Zhao Feng has to be captured alive.”

Thinking about the rewards the three sects were offering, even the emotionless Lord Hu Suo couldn’t suppress his excitement.

Whoosh! Whoosh!

Right at this moment, two figures broke through the surface of the water.

“Zhao Feng, you’re very courageous. I’m surprised that you dared to come out.”

Lord Hu Suo was slightly surprised. The three pirates thought that Zhao Feng would be too scared to come out and hide in the ocean.

“You’re indeed worthy of being the leader of the pirate alliance. I ran this far and you still managed to catch up.”

Zhao Feng waved his black flag and pretended to be extremely shocked.

In reality, even though he still didn’t know how they caught up to him, one thing was for certain: once a Great Origin Core Realm set their eyes on you, it would be hard to escape.

“Hahaha…. I’m the captain of the Blue Lightning Sea Sky Ship and have been with it for over two hundred years and personally fixed it many times. We’re already connected.”

The Blue Lightning Pirate laughed, and Lord Hu Suo nodded his head, “When a ship reaches a certain level, it will form a weak spirit and have a mysterious connection with its owner as long as they aren’t too far away.”

So that’s why.

Zhao Feng finally understood.

“This isn’t a secret, it’s just common knowledge.”

The black-armored giant said in disdain.

Common knowledge?

Zhao Feng and the skeletal Division Leader looked at each other with ugly expressions. They weren’t very experienced, and this was the first time Zhao Feng had even entered the outside world.

It seemed like they lost because of “common knowledge.”

“This Blue Lightning Pirate must die.”

Killing intent surged in Zhao Feng’s heart. Since he knew the reason now, there was no more need for talk.

Shua!

Sixty cursed ghost-corpses instantly appeared and formed a thick, dense black mist.

Boom! Boom! Hu~

Zhao Feng waved the black flag, and the power of the curse swept toward the three Sovereigns.

In just a short moment, everything within several miles was engulfed by the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array.

“Nine Deadly Yin Bone Stab!”

The skeletal Division Leader gritted its teeth and channeled its Earth-Grade weapon, sending a large dark silver spike toward the three enemies with the help of the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array.

“Hmm?”

Lord Hu Suo was slightly surprised.

Pi! Pa!

The Blue Lightning Pirate and the black-armored giant next to him were instantly forced to defend.

The power of the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array exceeded their expectations, and the power of the curse eroded them from every angle. Even Sovereigns found it troublesome.

The Nine Deadly Yin Bone Stab was also quite strong after being complemented by the power of the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array.

“This brat actually has so many tricks….”

The Blue Lightning Pirate hadn’t recovered yet, and his blood essence was being continuously devoured.

After just a couple exchanges, the Blue Lightning Pirate and the black-armored giant were put on the defensive.

Only Lord Hu Suo with his Great Origin Core Realm cultivation was standing motionless. A layer of green-and-blood-colored light surrounded him, pushing away any power of the curse that came near him.

That scene made the hearts of Zhao Feng and the skeletal Division Leader feel solemn.

“I’ll do it.”

Lord Hu Suo’s raspy voice sounded.

Shua! Shua!

The Blue Lightning Pirate and the black-armored giant revealed looks of joy and retreated, leaving a space for him.

“Break!”

Lord Hu Suo waved his palm.

Wu~~

Everything within several dozen miles was covered by the green-and-blood-colored light. Even space and the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi were starting to change.

Lord Hu Suo was like the Lord of Heaven and Earth, and he seemed able to turn the sun and moon around.

Bam!

The area seemed as if it were shaken by a beast as it started to tremble.

In this instant, both Zhao Feng and the skeletal Division Leader felt like ants fighting against an entire universe.

Crack!

The power of the curse was pushed back, and the mist of the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array instantly broke apart.

“What a terrifying attack.”

Zhao Feng’s blood churned as a small part of the attack hit him.

“You guys stall the brat. I’ll kill the skeleton first.”

Lord Hu Suo was extremely cautious. He was scared of accidentally injuring Zhao Feng.

The rewards offered by the three sects attracted even him, and they wanted him alive.

“Brat, you probably don’t even know how terrifying your enemy is.”

The Blue Lightning Pirate mocked.

“Hehe…. This brat even dared to challenge a Great Origin Core Realm.”

The black-armored man’s smile was full of disdain and mockery.

At this moment, since the Ghost Corpse Cursed Array was broken apart by Lord Hu Suo, Zhao Feng lost most of his protection.

Zhao Feng wasn’t a match for two late-stage Small Origin Core Realms even though he had an Earth-Grade weapon. Luckily, the three Sovereigns were all scared of accidentally killing Zhao Feng, so they didn’t go all-out.

Boom!

A large explosion came from the other side.

“Zhao Feng! Save me!”

The skeletal Division Leader screamed as two green-and-blood-colored dragons appeared.

Crack!

Cracks started to appear on the skeletal Division Leader’s bones.

Zhao Feng was shocked. He didn’t think that the skeletal Division Leader would lose so quickly. After the Nine Deadly Yin Bone merged into its body, the skeletal Division Leader’s defense rose dramatically, and it could take attacks from normal Sovereigns head-on.

Furthermore, he cultivated the Dao of Bone Strengthening. If it were a normal Sovereign in its place, their body would have already been crushed.

Crack!

The skeletal Division Leader’s body was about to shatter.

“Looks like I can’t hold back anymore….”

Zhao Feng took a deep breath. He was unable to deal with these two Sovereigns stalling him.

“Open!”

Zhao Feng’s expression was slightly grim as his eye and hair both turned blue.
